findings.description: A modern motorized ship hull appears in the background bay alongside historical sailing vessels.
findings.fix: Replace modern background vessel with a period-appropriate sailing ship or remove it.
findings.refined_description: A modern motorized boat/vessel with a contemporary cabin structure is visibly anchored in the bay in the background between the historical masted ship and the fortress.

findings.description: The massive iron harbor boom chain shows unusually flat tension across the wide harbor expanse.
findings.fix: Add natural catenary sag and water interaction along the chain span.

summary: Character identity and performance remain stable and expressive throughout the selfie-style take. Dialogue sync and natural lighting match the environment convincingly. Minor anachronistic background elements and rigid chain physics are the primary flaws.
